sources.title: GLM-5.2 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's flagship open-weight model for long-horizon coding and agentic work. It is a text-only Mixture-of-Experts model with 753B total parameters and approximately 40B active parameters, released under the MIT License.
